paths.#/server: The UI reaches data through RelayboardClient (#/client), never the server store. A route or component that imports the store has bypassed the seam the whole port rests on.
paths.#/server/store: The UI reaches data through RelayboardClient (#/client), never the server store. 06a's store singleton must stay unreachable from src/routes and src/components.
paths.#/server/store/demo-seed: The seed is an input to a store, not something a component reads. Read through RelayboardClient (#/client) instead.
paths.#/client/in-memory: A component reads the client from the router context (#/client/context), so the transport stays swappable. Constructing an in-memory client inside the UI would pin this screen to one implementation.
